requirements.title: Constructing the provider and resolving credentials
requirements.rationale: A missing or malformed credential must fail before any request, with an error that names the variable, and the provider must not read anything else from the environment.

criteria.condition: openrouter.New(m, opts) is called with a non-empty m.ID and OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolvable
criteria.action: build exactly one SDK client configured with the key, the resolved base URL, opts.HTTPClient when set and the SDK's own retries turned off, without making any network request
criteria.contract: returns a non-nil core.ProviderClient and a nil error; the exported constants are API core.API = "openrouter-chat", APIKeyVar = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", BaseURLVar = "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL", DefaultBaseURL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1" and DefaultMaxRetries = 2

setup: a core.Model with ID "vendor/model"
Options.Env holds OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL pointing at a recording server
check.pseudocode: c, err := New(m, Options{Env: env}); assert err == nil && c != nil; assert srv.Count() == 0; assert constants

criteria.action: resolve each variable from Options.Env first (an empty value falls through), then from Options.Getenv when it is non-nil or otherwise the process environment, treating an empty value as unset, and look up no variable other than OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
criteria.contract: a recording Getenv observes only the names OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL; an Env entry overrides a Getenv value for the same name

setup: a recording Getenv that logs every name asked
Getenv returns key "from-getenv"; Env sets OPENROUTER_API_KEY "from-env"
a second case where Env holds an empty key and Getenv returns a key
a third case with Getenv nil and the key in the process environment (t.Setenv)
check.pseudocode: for each case: New; Stream; read to end; assert srv.Last().Header("Authorization"); assert set(logged) ⊆ {APIKeyVar, BaseURLVar}

criteria.condition: OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolves to unset or empty
criteria.action: fail New without making any request
criteria.contract: New returns a nil client and an error for which errors.Is(err, openrouter.ErrNoAPIKey) is true and whose text contains "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"; the recording server receives 0 requests

setup: Env without OPENROUTER_API_KEY and a Getenv returning empty
a recording server as OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
check.pseudocode: c, err := New(m, opts); assert c == nil; assert errors.Is(err, ErrNoAPIKey); assert contains(err.Error(), "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"); assert srv.Count()==0

criteria.condition: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL is set but is not an absolute URL with scheme http or https
criteria.action: fail New without making any request
criteria.contract: New returns a nil client and an error whose text contains "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL" and the configured value with any user-info (user:password@) removed

setup: the key is set
base URLs: "not a url", "ftp://host/x", "/relative", "ftp://user:secret@host/x"
check.pseudocode: for u in urls: c, err := New(m, Options{Env: {key, BaseURLVar: u}}); assert c==nil; assert contains(err, BaseURLVar); assert !contains(err, "secret")

criteria.condition: m.ID is empty
criteria.action: fail New without making any request
criteria.contract: New returns a nil client and a non-nil error

setup: a core.Model with ID ""
the key is set
check.pseudocode: c, err := New(core.Model{}, opts); assert c == nil && err != nil

criteria.action: send every request as a POST to <base>/chat/completions, where <base> is OPENROUTER_BASE_URL with trailing '/' characters removed or DefaultBaseURL when the variable is unset, to that host only, carrying the key only in the header Authorization: Bearer <key>
criteria.contract: with OPENROUTER_BASE_URL unset, an HTTPClient transport records host openrouter.ai and path /api/v1/chat/completions without touching the network; no recorded request body or other header contains the key or any ANTHROPIC_* or OLLAMA_* value

setup: a recording HTTPClient transport that records method, host, path and headers and returns a canned SSE body without touching the network
a recording httptest server used with a base URL ending in "//"
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OLLAMA_HOST set in the process environment
check.pseudocode: assert rec.Method=="POST"; assert rec.Host=="openrouter.ai"; assert rec.Path=="/api/v1/chat/completions"; assert !bodyContains(key) && !headersExceptAuthContain(key)

criteria.condition: Stream is called with a context that is already done
criteria.action: refuse the call without making a request
criteria.contract: Stream returns a nil channel and that context's error; the recording server receives 0 requests

setup: a provider against a recording server
a context cancelled before the call
check.pseudocode: ch, err := c.Stream(cancelled, req); assert ch == nil; assert errors.Is(err, context.Canceled); assert srv.Count()==0

criteria.condition: several goroutines call Stream concurrently on one provider value
criteria.action: serve each call independently, encoding every failure after Stream returns inside that call's stream
criteria.contract: every call's channel ends with its own MessageEndEvent and result; go test -race reports no data race

setup: one provider value against a recording server replaying a canned text stream
16 goroutines
check.pseudocode: parallel 16x { ch := Stream(); events := drain(ch); assert last(events) is MessageEndEvent }

requirements.title: Encoding the request
requirements.rationale: The second turn of a tool loop only works if model id, tool schemas, argument strings and results reach OpenRouter exactly as the transcript holds them.

criteria.action: send model equal to m.ID byte for byte with nothing stripped or rewritten, stream true and stream_options.include_usage true in every request body
criteria.contract: the recorded body has model == m.ID, stream == true and stream_options.include_usage == true

setup: m.ID "Vendor/Model:Free-v1.2"
Request.System of two text blocks "A" and "B"
a second request with no system text
check.pseudocode: assert body.model==m.ID; assert body.stream_options.include_usage; assert body.messages[0]=={role:system, content:"A\n\nB"}; assert count(role==system)<=1

criteria.action: join the core.TextBlocks of Request.System with a blank line ("\n\n") into one leading system message, and send no system message when Request.System has no text
criteria.contract: the recorded messages array has at most one system message and, when present, it is element 0

criteria.action: encode the repaired Request.Prefix followed by the repaired Request.Messages in order, with no cache marker; a core.UserMessage becomes a user message with its text blocks in order and is skipped when it has no text; each core.ToolResultMessage becomes its own tool message with tool_call_id equal to the call's id and content equal to provider.ToolResultText(v)
criteria.contract: an error result's recorded content starts with "Error: "; the recorded body contains no cache_control field

setup: a Prefix with one user message
Messages holding a text-less user message, an assistant call, two tool results (one IsError) and a final user message
check.pseudocode: assert roles(body.messages)==[...]; assert body.messages[k].content==provider.ToolResultText(v); assert !contains(rawBody, "cache_control")

criteria.action: encode a core.AssistantMessage as an assistant message whose content is its text blocks joined (absent when there is no text) and whose tool_calls carry id, type "function", function.name and function.arguments equal to string(ToolUseBlock.Input) without decoding and re-encoding, and skip an assistant message with no text, no tool calls and no reasoning to replay
criteria.contract: the recorded function.arguments string is byte-identical to the Input bytes received on the previous turn, including whitespace and key order

setup: an assistant message with text and a tool call whose Input is {"b": 1,  "a":[1, 2]} with odd whitespace and key order
an assistant message with no text, no tool calls and no reasoning
an assistant message with only tool calls
check.pseudocode: assert body.messages[i].tool_calls[0].function.arguments == string(input)

criteria.action: declare each tool as {"type":"function","function":{"name","description","parameters"}} where parameters is the tool's schema exactly as (*schema.Schema).MarshalJSON renders it, declare a tool with a nil schema with parameters {"type":"object","properties":{}}, and send no strict flag
criteria.contract: the recorded parameters bytes equal the schema's MarshalJSON output, preserving property order, additionalProperties, format and bounds; no tool object contains a strict key

setup: a tool whose schema has properties in non-alphabetical order, additionalProperties false, a format and min/max bounds
a tool with a nil schema
check.pseudocode: want,_ := s.MarshalJSON(); assert rawParams(0)==want; assert json(rawParams(1))=={type:object,properties:{}}; assert !contains(rawTools,"strict")

criteria.action: send tool_choice "auto" for core.ToolChoiceAuto and "none" for core.ToolChoiceNone, and omit tool_choice when the choice is core.ToolChoiceUnset
criteria.contract: the recorded body has the matching tool_choice value or no tool_choice key

setup: requests with ToolChoiceAuto, ToolChoiceNone and ToolChoiceUnset
check.pseudocode: assert body.tool_choice == "auto"; assert body.tool_choice == "none"; assert !has(body,"tool_choice")

criteria.action: send max_completion_tokens as *Request.MaxTokens when that is positive, capped at m.MaxOutputTokens when the cap is positive; otherwise as m.MaxOutputTokens when that is positive; otherwise omit the field
criteria.contract: MaxTokens 200000 with cap 131072 records 131072; MaxTokens 4096 records 4096; nil MaxTokens with cap 32768 records 32768; nil MaxTokens with cap 0 records no max_completion_tokens key

check.pseudocode: table-driven; assert body["max_completion_tokens"] equals expected or key absent

criteria.action: send temperature and top_p whenever their pointers are non-nil, including an explicit 0, and send stop when StopSequences is non-empty
criteria.contract: a pointer to 0.0 records temperature 0; nil pointers and an empty StopSequences record no temperature, top_p or stop key

setup: Temperature pointer to 0.0, TopP pointer to 0.0, StopSequences ["END"]
a request with nil pointers and empty StopSequences
check.pseudocode: assert has(body,"temperature") && body.temperature==0; assert !has(body2,"stop")

requirements.title: Effort
requirements.rationale: Effort must follow the catalog row's Efforts map the same way the Anthropic provider reads it, never clamped and never invalid on the wire.

criteria.condition: Request.Effort is empty
criteria.action: send no reasoning object so that the vendor's default applies
criteria.contract: the recorded body has no reasoning key

setup: Efforts nil with effort "high"
Efforts {low,medium,high,max} with effort "xhigh"
Efforts with a nil entry for "low"
empty Request.Effort
check.pseudocode: assert !has(body,"reasoning") for 3 cases; assert body.reasoning.effort=="high"

criteria.condition: Request.Effort is non-empty and m.Efforts is nil
criteria.action: use the effort's own name as the wire value
criteria.contract: Effort "high" with a nil map records reasoning.effort == "high"

criteria.condition: Request.Effort is non-empty and m.Efforts is non-nil but has no entry, or a nil entry, for that effort
criteria.action: send no reasoning object
criteria.contract: Effort "xhigh" against a map holding low, medium, high and max records no reasoning key

criteria.condition: a wire value is selected for the effort
criteria.action: send the value as reasoning.max_tokens when it parses as a positive integer and as reasoning.effort otherwise
criteria.contract: a map value "8192" records reasoning.max_tokens == 8192 and no reasoning.effort; a map value "medium" records reasoning.effort == "medium" and no reasoning.max_tokens

setup: Efforts map value "8192" for "high" and "medium" for "low"
a request with Effort "max" mapped to "max", Temperature 0.3, TopP 0.9
check.pseudocode: assert body.reasoning.max_tokens==8192 && !has(body.reasoning,"effort")

criteria.action: never substitute another effort level for the requested one and never remove temperature or top_p because an effort is sent
criteria.contract: a request with Effort "max", Temperature 0.3 and TopP 0.9 records reasoning.effort "max", temperature 0.3 and top_p 0.9

requirements.title: Replaying the transcript
requirements.rationale: Chat-style wires reject unpaired tool calls, and OpenRouter reasoning must round-trip as reasoning_details, never as visible text.

criteria.action: return a repaired view of its input messages without modifying the input, dropping every assistant message whose StopReason is StopReasonError or StopReasonAborted, then dropping every tool result whose call id is not in a kept assistant message
criteria.contract: returns (core.Messages, report) where the report counts dropped assistant messages and dropped orphan results; the input slice and its messages are deep-equal to their state before the call

setup: an assistant message with StopReasonError and its tool result
an assistant message with StopReasonAborted
a kept assistant message with calls A, B, C and a result only for B, followed by a user message
a deep copy of the input taken before the call
check.pseudocode: out, rep := provider.RepairToolPairing(in); assert deepEqual(in, copy); assert ids(results(out))==[A,B,C]; assert rep.Inserted==2

criteria.action: for every tool call in a kept assistant message that has no result, insert an error tool result with text "No result provided" at that call's position among the turn's results, before the next non-result message
criteria.contract: the report counts inserted results; for calls A, B, C with only B answered, the results following the assistant message are ordered A(synthetic), B, C(synthetic)

criteria.action: for any transcript, produce output in which every tool call of a kept assistant message is followed by exactly one result with its id before the next non-result message, no thinking block is altered, and repairing the output again reports zero changes
criteria.contract: property holds over generated transcripts mixing errored, aborted, answered and unanswered turns

setup: generated transcripts mixing errored, aborted, answered and unanswered assistant turns, with thinking blocks and orphan results
check.pseudocode: for t in gen(): o,_ := Repair(t); assert paired(o); assert thinkingEqual(o,t); o2,r2 := Repair(o); assert !r2.Changed() && equal(o,o2)

criteria.condition: Stream encodes a request
criteria.action: run the shared repair on Request.Prefix and on Request.Messages before encoding, and report a non-zero change count through Options.Warnf
criteria.contract: Warnf is called once per repaired part with a non-zero count and is not called when nothing changed

setup: a prefix with an unanswered tool call
history with an errored assistant turn
a clean second request
a recording Warnf
check.pseudocode: assert len(warns)==2 after req1; assert len(warns)==2 after req2

criteria.action: send every tool-call id and tool_call_id unchanged, whichever model produced it
criteria.contract: an id "toolu_01abc" produced by another provider is recorded as "toolu_01abc" in both tool_calls[].id and tool_call_id

setup: an assistant message from a different model with tool call id "toolu_01abc" and its result
check.pseudocode: assert body.messages[1].tool_calls[0].id=="toolu_01abc"; assert body.messages[2].tool_call_id=="toolu_01abc"

criteria.condition: an assistant message being encoded has Model equal to m.ID
criteria.action: send reasoning_details as the concatenation, in block order, of each thinking block's Signature parsed as a JSON array, with a Signature that is empty or not a JSON array contributing nothing
criteria.contract: the recorded reasoning_details elements are byte-equivalent JSON to the fragments received on the earlier turn, in arrival order and with every field

setup: a same-model assistant message with two thinking blocks whose Signatures are JSON arrays with extra fields, plus a third block with Signature "" and a fourth with "not json"
a message from another model with a signed thinking block
check.pseudocode: assert jsonEqual(body.messages[1].reasoning_details, concat(sig1, sig2)); assert !has(body.messages[3],"reasoning_details")

criteria.condition: an assistant message being encoded has Model different from m.ID
criteria.action: send no reasoning_details for that message
criteria.contract: the recorded assistant message has no reasoning_details key

criteria.action: never place a thinking block's Thinking text in any message's content
criteria.contract: a transcript whose thinking text is a unique marker string yields a recorded body in which no content field contains the marker

setup: same-model and other-model assistant messages with thinking text "UNIQUE-MARKER-7f3"
check.pseudocode: for m in body.messages: assert !contains(m.content, MARKER)

requirements.title: Decoding the stream
requirements.rationale: Consumers render events as they arrive and the loop acts on the final message, so events, block indices and stop reasons must follow the vendor's stream exactly.

criteria.action: emit exactly one MessageStartEvent per turn before any content event, not emitting another for a retried attempt, with the partial message's Model set to m.ID, Effort set to Request.Effort and Timestamp from Options.Now when set or the clock otherwise
criteria.contract: a turn that succeeds on its second attempt delivers exactly one MessageStartEvent

setup: a recording server answering 503 first and then a successful stream
Options.Now returning a fixed time, Retry-After: 0
Request.Effort "low"
check.pseudocode: assert count(events, MessageStartEvent)==1; assert index(start) < index(firstContent)

criteria.action: assign block indices from 0 in order of first appearance, open a new block whenever the delta kind changes between text, thinking and tool call, emit events in the order the vendor sends the deltas, and ignore choices other than index 0, empty deltas, role-only deltas and SSE comments such as ": OPENROUTER PROCESSING" without treating them as content
criteria.contract: a stream of thinking, text, tool-call deltas yields blocks 0 thinking, 1 text, 2 tool call; a stream interleaving keep-alive comments yields the same events as one without them

setup: an SSE body with keep-alive comments ": OPENROUTER PROCESSING", a role-only delta, an empty delta and a choice with index 1, between reasoning, text and tool-call deltas
check.pseudocode: assert types(events)==[Start, ThinkStart(0), ThinkDelta(0), TextStart(1), ...]; assert equal(events, eventsClean)

criteria.condition: a chunk carries a non-empty delta.content
criteria.action: emit TextStartEvent when the delta opens a text block, then TextDeltaEvent with the delta
criteria.contract: TextDeltaEvent.Delta equals delta.content and its BlockIndex equals the open text block's index

setup: an SSE body with content deltas "Hel" and "lo"
check.pseudocode: assert deltas==["Hel","lo"]; assert end.Text=="Hello"

criteria.condition: a chunk carries delta.reasoning or delta.reasoning_details
criteria.action: append each reasoning_details element with all its fields to the open thinking block's fragment list (opening a block if none is open), take the visible text from delta.reasoning when present or else from reasoning.text text and reasoning.summary summary fields (encrypted fragments add no text), and emit ThinkingStartEvent and ThinkingDeltaEvent for it, never text events
criteria.contract: the finished core.ThinkingBlock has Thinking equal to the accumulated text, Signature equal to the JSON array of its fragments in arrival order (empty when none arrived) and Redacted false

setup: chunks with delta.reasoning plus reasoning_details fragments carrying extra fields (id, format, index)
a chunk with only reasoning.text, reasoning.summary and reasoning.encrypted fragments and no delta.reasoning
check.pseudocode: assert jsonEqual(block.Signature, fragments); assert block.Thinking=="..."; assert !block.Redacted

criteria.condition: a chunk carries delta.tool_calls fragments
criteria.action: accumulate fragments by index, emit ToolCallStartEvent on the first fragment carrying id and name, emit ToolInputDeltaEvent with each function.arguments fragment as received, finalize the call with core.NewToolUse over the byte-for-byte concatenation of the fragments (empty becomes {}), and give a call that arrives without an id the id call_ followed by random hex unique within the turn
criteria.contract: the final ToolUseBlock.Input equals the concatenated argument bytes; two id-less calls in one turn receive distinct call_<hex> ids

setup: two interleaved tool calls split over several fragments with whitespace-bearing arguments
two calls without ids in one turn
a call with empty arguments
check.pseudocode: assert string(block.Input)==join(fragments); assert ids[0]!=ids[1]; assert match("^call_[0-9a-f]+$", ids[0])

criteria.condition: a tool call's concatenated arguments are not a JSON object
criteria.action: finalize the call with Input {} and report the call's id and name through Options.Warnf
criteria.contract: ToolUseBlock.Input == {}; the Warnf output contains the call's id and name

setup: a call id "call_x" name "read" with arguments "[1,2" or "\"str\""
a recording Warnf
check.pseudocode: assert string(block.Input)=="{}"; assert contains(warns[0], "call_x") && contains(warns[0], "read")

criteria.condition: a choice has carried a finish_reason
criteria.action: continue reading to the end of the body to collect usage, then emit TextEndEvent, ThinkingEndEvent and ToolCallEndEvent in block order once each with the whole block, then a MessageEndEvent with the final message
criteria.contract: the stream result's Message equals the MessageEndEvent message and its Err is nil; usage sent after the finish chunk is present in the final message

setup: a body with text, a tool call, a finish chunk, then a usage chunk with empty choices, then [DONE]
check.pseudocode: assert order(events)==[...,TextEnd(0),ToolCallEnd(1),MessageEnd]; assert res.Message==end.Message; assert res.Message.Usage.Reported()

criteria.action: keep finish_reason verbatim in RawStopReason and map stop to StopReasonStop, length to StopReasonLength, tool_calls to StopReasonToolUse, content_filter to StopReasonRefusal and any other value except error to StopReasonStop, keep tool calls in the message whatever the finish reason, and set ResponseID and ResponseModel from the chunks' id and model
criteria.contract: a stream with tool calls and finish_reason "stop" yields a message with StopReasonStop that still contains its ToolUseBlocks

setup: streams ending with stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter and an unknown value "weird"
a stream with a tool call and finish_reason "stop"
chunks carrying id "gen-1" and model "vendor/served"
check.pseudocode: table-driven over finish reasons; assert msg.StopReason==want && msg.RawStopReason==raw

requirements.title: Truncated streams and errors inside the stream
requirements.rationale: A Chat Completions tool call is only known complete at finish_reason, so a broken stream must fail the turn without leaving anything executable.

criteria.condition: the response body ends without any choice having carried a finish_reason
criteria.action: fail the turn
criteria.contract: the result's Err satisfies errors.Is(err, openrouter.ErrStreamTruncated) and its text is "openrouter: stream ended before finish_reason"; the message has StopReasonError and no ToolUseBlock

setup: a body with text and a partial tool call, ending after [DONE] or EOF without any finish_reason
check.pseudocode: assert errors.Is(res.Err, ErrStreamTruncated); assert res.Err.Error()=="openrouter: stream ended before finish_reason"; assert len(ExtractToolUse(msg))==0

criteria.condition: an in-stream error with code 429 or in 500–599 arrives and no content event has been emitted for the turn and retries remain
criteria.action: discard the attempt and retry it under the retry policy of 27-REQ-7
criteria.contract: the recording server receives one more request; the consumer sees no event from the discarded attempt

setup: the first 200 stream is an error chunk code 429 (or 502) with no content, with Retry-After: 0
the second response is a good stream
check.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==2; assert noEventsFrom(attempt1)

criteria.condition: an in-stream error arrives after a content event, with a code other than 429 or 500–599, or with no retries remaining
criteria.action: fail the turn without retrying
criteria.contract: the result's Err is a *openrouter.StatusError whose Code is the vendor's code and whose Text is "openrouter: error <code> in stream: <message>"

setup: a stream with text then an error chunk code 429
a stream with an error chunk code 400 and no content
a stream with an error chunk code 503 and MaxRetries 0
check.pseudocode: var se *StatusError; assert errors.As(res.Err,&se); assert se.Code==429; assert se.Text=="openrouter: error 429 in stream: slow down"

criteria.action: give every failed (non-aborted) turn's message StopReasonError, ErrorMessage equal to the error text, the text and thinking blocks streamed so far, no tool-call blocks, and whatever usage had arrived, priced as in 27-REQ-8
criteria.contract: core.ExtractToolUse on the failed message returns no calls

setup: a stream with thinking, text, a complete tool call, a usage chunk and then an in-stream error code 400 after content
check.pseudocode: assert last2(events)==[ErrorEvent(Terminal), MessageEnd]; assert res.Err==errEvent.Err; assert msg.ErrorMessage==res.Err.Error()

criteria.condition: a turn fails for any reason other than cancellation
criteria.action: emit a terminal ErrorEvent, then the MessageEndEvent, then end the stream with the result carrying Err
criteria.contract: the last two events are ErrorEvent{Terminal: true} and MessageEndEvent, and the stream result's Err equals the ErrorEvent's Err

requirements.title: HTTP errors, retries, cancellation and credential redaction
requirements.rationale: The SDK skips 429, cannot see in-stream errors and can back off for an hour, so the provider owns one bounded retry loop and must never leak the key.

criteria.condition: an attempt receives an HTTP 429 or 5xx response and fewer than MaxRetries retries have been made, where a nil Options.MaxRetries means DefaultMaxRetries (2) and a negative value means 0
criteria.action: retry the request
criteria.contract: with default options and three 503 responses followed by success, the recording server receives exactly 3 requests and the turn fails; with MaxRetries 0 it receives exactly 1 request

setup: a server that answers 503 with Retry-After: 0 on every request
a server answering 429 then 200
check.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==3; assert srv0.Count()==1

criteria.condition: the provider waits before a retry
criteria.action: wait for the response's Retry-After value (delta-seconds or HTTP date) when it lies between 0 and 60 seconds inclusive, and otherwise wait 0.5 s doubling per retry up to a cap of 8 s with up to 25% jitter
criteria.contract: Retry-After: 0 retries without delay; Retry-After: 120 falls back to the exponential curve, observable through the unexported backoff hook

setup: the unexported backoff hook recording each wait
responses with Retry-After: 0, 5, an HTTP date 3 s ahead (via Options.Now), 120 and none
check.pseudocode: assert wait(ra="0")==0; assert wait(ra="120") in [0.5,0.625]; assert wait(attempt=10) <= 8*1.25

criteria.condition: retries are exhausted on a 429, 5xx or retryable in-stream error
criteria.action: end the turn with the last error
criteria.contract: the result's Err is a *openrouter.StatusError carrying the last status code; the message has StopReasonError

setup: a server answering 503 then 502 then 429 with Retry-After: 0 and default retries
check.pseudocode: assert se.Code==429; assert msg.StopReason==StopReasonError

criteria.condition: an attempt receives HTTP 401 or 403
criteria.action: fail the turn at once without retrying
criteria.contract: the recording server receives 1 request; the result's Err is a *openrouter.StatusError with that Code and Text "openrouter: HTTP <code>: <vendor message>" followed by a note naming OPENROUTER_API_KEY

setup: a server answering 401 (and in a second case 403) with error.message "bad key"
check.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==1; assert se.Code==401; assert hasPrefix(se.Text,"openrouter: HTTP 401: bad key") && contains(se.Text,"OPENROUTER_API_KEY")

criteria.condition: an attempt receives any other non-2xx status, such as 400 or 402
criteria.action: fail the turn without retrying, using the body's error.message as the vendor message when present
criteria.contract: the result's Err is a *openrouter.StatusError with that Code and Text "openrouter: HTTP <code>: <vendor message>"; the recording server receives 1 request

setup: servers answering 400 and 402 with a JSON error.message, and one with a non-JSON body
check.pseudocode: assert se.Text=="openrouter: HTTP 402: insufficient credits"; assert srv.Count()==1

criteria.condition: an attempt fails with no HTTP response, such as a refused connection
criteria.action: fail the turn without retrying
criteria.contract: the result's Err text is "openrouter: <error>" and the message has StopReasonError

setup: a base URL pointing at a closed port, or an HTTPClient returning an error
check.pseudocode: assert hasPrefix(res.Err.Error(),"openrouter: "); assert attempts==1

criteria.condition: the caller's context is cancelled during a request, during streaming or during a wait between attempts
criteria.action: stop the request and any pending wait within 1 second and end the turn as aborted
criteria.contract: the message has StopReasonAborted and ErrorMessage "Request was aborted"; the result's Err satisfies errors.Is(err, core.ErrAborted); the channel is closed

setup: a server that hangs before responding
a server that sends text then stalls
a server answering 503 with Retry-After: 60 so the provider is waiting
check.pseudocode: cancel(); assert closedWithin(1s); assert msg.StopReason==StopReasonAborted; assert errors.Is(res.Err, core.ErrAborted)

criteria.action: for any error text, ErrorEvent, ErrorMessage or Warnf output the provider builds, replace every occurrence of the API key with "[redacted]"
criteria.contract: with a vendor error message and a base URL that echo the key, no returned error string, event, message field or Warnf line contains the key

setup: generated API keys of varied length and characters
a server whose error.message, in-stream error message and tool-call name echo the key, and a base URL containing the key as a path segment
a recording Warnf

symbols.notes: Assumed streaming entry point; the response exposes an event stream with Next() bool, Value(), Err() error and Close() error. Whether request types carry schema property order and every reasoning_details field without loss is unverified.
